Welcome to Librarybase, the collaborative card catalog of everything.

Librarybase is a project to organize, refine, and distribute metadata, as a complement to other projects like Wikidata or OpenAlex. For more information about Librarybase:

  • Project:Principles: The motivations behind the project
  • Project:Scope: What is accepted for inclusion on this wiki
  • Project:Consensus: How decisions are made here
